svg.title: Thus the exact normalization does not spoil any other leading position test. The endpoint also compares this construction with numerical jets of finite Wilson data. For a fixed finite torus with side greater than one, let wQ,l(m) denote the coefficient of order lof its regulated profile series at mesh parameter m. Its order-zero coefficients tend to w0 Q as m →∞. For a fixed truncation order p, form the finite polynomial curve cQ,p,m(t) = Pp l=0 tlwQ,l(m). This curve is used only to compute numerical derivatives. It requires no convergence of the full formal series. Equation (PT6) holds along the curve near t = 0, for all sufficiently large m, because its base point tends to w0 Q. Therefore every positive derivative at zero of CQ(cQ,p,m(t), φ(cQ,p,m(t))) vanishes exactly, and its zeroth derivative equals the prescribed constant.
